result: Verified in the isolated installed-wheel Prefect suite: 30 passed in 39.93s; focused coverage: tests/prefect/test_managed_prefect_0_58.py::test_process_worker_executes_targeted_csv_and_postgresql_transfers.
assertions: A real Process worker exited after PostgreSQL prepared the target replacement and effect-ledger insert inside an open transaction but before commit.
While the worker was held at that boundary, another connection observed no target rows or effect-ledger entry; canonical effect evidence was absent and report publication remained pending.
After the worker process exited, PostgreSQL rolled back the unsettled transaction and the target and effect ledger remained empty.
After releasing the lost execution lease, recovery recorded the first attempt as lost, executed a second attempt, and published a successful canonical report.
The recovered submission produced the expected PostgreSQL row and exactly one committed effect-ledger record.
The fixture ran from a separately built backend-plugin wheel with inherited PYTHONPATH unset and used a separately supervised Prefect server with its own PostgreSQL database.

runtime.wheel_environment: Fresh virtual environment; inherited PYTHONPATH unset; pytest pythonpath override disabled repository source injection; package origins asserted under site-packages in the live Process-worker test.

limitations: This campaign kills the worker after the sink transaction is fully staged but before commit; it does not cover a failure midway through a multi-statement connector write.
Delayed report/event/artifact publication, independent production consumers, and the remaining phase 0.58 lifecycle and authorization gates remain unqualified.
